To: Pat Dunne <pat.dunne@echelonhealth.com>, Eve Marshall <eve.marshall@echelonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP reset: evaluation scope & timeline (Echelon Health)

Hi Pat and Eve,

Thanks again for the note and for introducing Eve. Given the org change you mentioned, we wanted to re-kick the mutual action plan so everyone has aligned expectations and roles. I attached an editable MAP (echelon_map_v2.xlsx) that pares the evaluation down to a 4-week POC focused on latency, cost-per-token, and secure KV caching. High-level proposal: 

- Week 0: kickoff + access provisioning (Echelon infra contact)
- Week 1–2: POC integration (embedding + retrieval flow)
- Week 3: load/latency verification and tuning
- Week 4: final review, success criteria sign-off and next steps

Proposed owners (please feel free to update):
- Echelon champion: Eve Marshall (evaluation owner)
- Procurement: Pat Dunne
- Redwood AE: Sergio Alvarez (me)
- Redwood SE: Neha Kapoor (technical lead)
- Redwood CSM: Marissa Cole (onboarding/rollout readiness)

Two asks to unblock scheduling: 1) confirm Eve as the evaluation owner, and 2) share the infra contact who will grant a test environment (or tell us if you want Redwood to provision a short-lived demo VPC). I also attached a short SOC2 summary we typically share for procurement.

If this looks good I can send a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff next week and drop an updated MAP with milestones into the Drive link below.

Thanks —
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Eve, can you confirm your availability next Wednesday or Thursday for a kickoff? Also FYI, our infra owner is Rajesh Patel (rajesh.patel@echelonhealth.com) — he'll handle temporary test VM access.

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear plan and Pat for the intro. I can take point on the evaluation. A couple of clarifying notes from my side: 

- We want the POC scope narrowed to the retrieval + generation path for our clinical notes ingestion pipeline; we do not need full platform feature parity during the POC.
- Procurement will need the SOC2 summary you attached; they may push for an NDA addendum before data access.
- Rajesh will provision a staging VM with SSH access; I will confirm the window.

If you can update the MAP to reflect the trimmed scope (integration + success criteria) and include the estimated token budget for Week 1–3, that would help me get internal approval faster. I'm available next Wednesday (20 Oct) 10–12 PT or Thursday 21 Oct after 1 PM PT.

Eve
Head of Machine Learning
Echelon Health
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Eve Marshall <eve.marshall@echelonhealth.com>, Pat Dunne <pat.dunne@echelonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, procurement@echelonhealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP reset: evaluation scope & timeline (Echelon Health)

Eve / Pat — thanks, that's helpful. I've updated the MAP to reflect the narrower POC (integration + retrieval+generation) and added a token budget estimate (see attached echelon_map_v2.xlsx). Summary of changes and owners below: 

- Scope: ingest clinical notes -> embedding -> retrieval -> condensed generation for clinician view (no analytics/workflow integration in POC)
- Success criteria (sample): end-to-end latency < 300ms 95th, retrieval MRR@10 >= 0.72 for test set, and stable cost < $0.02 per 1k tokens for runtime baseline
- Token budget: estimated 150k tokens total across Week 1–3 (detailed sheet in the MAP)
- Owners: Eve (evaluation sign-off), Rajesh (infra access), procurement@echelonhealth.com (PO/NDA), Neha (SE lead), Marissa (CSM onboarding readiness)

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm kickoff time (I can do Wed 20 Oct 10:30 PT).
2) Eve to confirm Rajesh will share SSH keys and a staging endpoint by Mon 18 Oct.
3) Procurement to confirm whether an NDA addendum is needed — if so, we'll provide a lightweight addendum draft.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/rdw/echelon-map-v2
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4598

If that schedule works I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-kick checklist for Rajesh (SSH user, test dataset link, outbound IP whitelist).

— Sergio
